tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin shangs lugs kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs so// ha ya gṛ ba na maḥ shangs lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bha buddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du/ hrīḥlas padma hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po g.yas zhal ljang khu/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bgrad pa mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu gsum gyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu gsum kha gdangs shing rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas stong gsum gang ba/ phyag drug g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭwām̐ ka gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon dang po na sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung / gsum pa na rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang / zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thab can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ mi'i skra'i tshangs skud dang / khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa bzhi bskum zhing / g.yon pa bzhi brkyang bas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyis rnam par brdzis pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rta mgrin mtshon gang pas go mtshams med par gtams pa rang dang de thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrog cing me dpung 'bar bas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad gzhob thul thul bsregs par bsams la/

oṃ hrīḥpadma ta krita badzra kro dha ha ya gri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong la sogs pa bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra dun bhyo/ tig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya bzlog sa ma ya bhyo/ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ ces pa'i drag sngags 'di yang nyer gcig tsam re bzlas pa'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog/ //ces brjod do/ /dpal rta mgrin shangs lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'o// //maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rta mgrin shangs lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
